## Editorial request

The editor reviews argument/evidence/comprehension before language, using at most five located high-impact findings per round plus a grouped remainder. Minimal grammar/spelling suggestions reference existing text and never replace your voice. You apply every correction. There are no generated scripts, titles, captions, intros, or outreach messages, no prose commits, and no automatic publishing.
